requirements.evidence: Stacked full bases at 0,0,0 and 0,0,1 (snap 0,0,0) give level 0 and level 1; plus half-n at -1,0,0 for drawer. measure y=169mm confirms two levels.
bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full on level 1 with cover:0,0,1;full;top; dressed with heap-screws staging inside bin.

finish.summary: Two-storey organizer built: full hex at 0,0 stacked 0→1 gives the two storeys, half-n at -1,0,0 hosts a south-facing drawer below, a full bin on the level-1 top provides top storage, and all open faces were capped (11 caps) and joints locked. check_build clear.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
